schema.name: run_id
schema.description: The investigation this snapshot is of.

schema.name: created_at
schema.description: When the investigation was scheduled; the same on every snapshot of it.

schema.name: updated_at
schema.description: When this snapshot was written. A run is its newest snapshot.

schema.name: trigger_type
schema.description: What launched the run: manual, custom, scheduled, task_fire or update.

schema.name: metrics
schema.description: Metrics evaluated, keyed by metric type.

schema.name: custom_overrides
schema.description: Selector SQL and reviewer focus for a custom investigation.

schema.name: effective_config
schema.description: Config snapshot taken at submit time; the durable job runs the graph from this.

schema.name: due_at
schema.description: When the delayed trigger of a scheduled run is due to start it.

schema.name: status
schema.description: scheduled, pending, running, done, failed or skipped.

schema.name: job_name
schema.description: Resource name of the durable long-running query job.

schema.name: summary
schema.description: Terminal run summary. The progress events live in investigation_events.

schema.name: counters
schema.description: Flat integer counts of what the run saw: traces scanned, ingested and evaluated, and the rubrics, clusters and insights they produced.
